every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 maintains a clear, continuous camera path across the workbench from frames 1 to 9, whereas Site 2 collides text with 3D subjects in frame 1 and obscures the background scene completely in frame 9.

explains_the_project.reason: Site 1 uses concrete physical metaphors like the capture press compressing blocks in frames 3-4 and a filing cabinet in frame 5, whereas Site 2 relies mostly on abstract floating rings and emblems in frames 1-3.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Site 1 grounds its textured industrial machinery with shadows on a shared floor plane across frames 1-9, while Site 2 floats disconnected, emissive primitives in empty space in frames 2-8.

type_and_layout.reason: Site 1 keeps readable, compact cards pinned cleanly to the left in frames 1-9, while Site 2 suffers from text overlapping the 3D logo in frame 1 and clipped cards under the header in frames 4 and 5.

overall.reason: Site 1 delivers a cohesive, grounded 3D workbench narrative that clearly visualizes how Straitjacket processes logs without layout collisions.
